name: Byte Breach
detailed_description:
BREACH AI MEGACORPS

In a dystopian future, AI megacorporations control all data. You are a Breacher: a skilled operative taking on high-stakes contracts to steal vital information. For profit, principle, or survival – team up (1-4 players, solo viable) in this tense co-op sci-fi horror where evasion is life.

HACK THE DIGITAL WORLD

Activate Digital Vision: an integrated AR overlay revealing the hidden digital network interwoven with physical reality. Exploit this layer to trace data streams, spot AI signatures, and bypass security. Data theft is an art - execute skill-based micro-challenges via your gadget and manage unstable data siphons. Master both realities to gain the upper hand.

CO-OP (1-4) SYNERGY IS KEY

True teamwork is your greatest asset. Assist teammates during complex data interactions, share limited items, and coordinate cross-realm strategies to survive the breach together.

INFINITE HEISTS

Procedurally generated facilities and dynamic AI threat escalation ensure no two data heists are ever the same.

EVOLVE YOUR BREACHER

Dive into the Byte Web: spend Knowledge Nodes (KNs) earned from missions to unlock a vast network of Perks. Combine them freely to create your unique loadout, upgrading abilities and tailoring your strategy. Rise through Cyber Ranks by completing challenging Multi-Stage Assignments to access higher-tier abilities and game-changing Perk Specializations. Define your edge.

FACE ESCALATING SECURITY

You're not hitting static targets. Corporate AI tracks your team's "Digital Footprint." As your notoriety grows, security protocols escalate: expect more advanced AI units, sophisticated digital ICE (Intrusion Countermeasure Electronics), and facility countermeasures tailored to challenge your crew. Every run evolves.

RISK VS. REWARD

Met your initial objective? Extract with your loot and live to breach another day, or push deeper for greater rewards against amplified threats. Your call.

THE RESURGENCE CHIP

Death isn't always the end. The Resurgence Chip offers a unique chance to return with new support capabilities and aid your crew.
